note:
Coverage. Twenty-seven pages, thirty-five measured regions on eighteen of them, and every region accounted exactly once: twenty-three figure rows, five table rows and seven exclusions. The paper prints twenty-seven numbered figures and two numbered tables, and it also prints three grids that carry no number at all (the Model Parameters grid on p13 and both results grids on p21). Twenty-seven figure numbers over twenty-three rows because four measured boxes each hold two separately captioned printed figures - pages 16 and 18, one pair per box.

Region count is not exhibit count, in both directions at once. Four boxes buy eight printed figures, so the figure rows UNDERCOUNT printed numbers by four, while Figures 3, 5, 7, 8 and 13 are tables wearing figure numbers, so the family aggregate overstates drawn charts by five. No region is a duplicate detection and none is a fragment of another: this is the first paper in the recent run with a clean one-to-one between boxes and claimed exhibits apart from the four paired boxes.

Two pages are pasted page images, and they swallow a whole subsection. Pages 13 and 14 return 83 characters of text layer each - a watermark and a running head - because the 5.2 heading, Figure 14's grid, Figure 14's caption and an unnumbered parameter grid are pixels, in a different typeface at a left margin of 99 pt against the native 86 pt. Figure 14's caption is typed from the crop; the parameter grid has no caption to type. The 5.2 heading never reaches the text layer, so the section paths of every row that belongs to it take the last numbered heading the layer still prints, and the note on Table 2 says so.

Apparatus limits worth keeping. Caption-side and rule-style readings here needed the crops: the crops are what showed that page 5's only region is bitmapped prose, that the two page-15 equation strips carry no exhibit, that page 20's first region is a pair of satellite basemaps and not a schematic, and that both page-21 grids are raster images with no caption. No detector change was made; the one region that stayed unread at the eight-proxy limit was settled by rule and ink profiling on the original rasters.

What the custody buys. Every caption in this record is a verbatim substring of the page that prints it, except Figure 14's typed-from-crop string; every lead and trail sentence is a verbatim substring within one page of its exhibit; the seven exclusions name page and bounding box and give the reason they hold no exhibit. The citation picture is the paper's real finding: thirty-one rows carry an empty style list, because this team points at every exhibit with 'below', 'above' and 'as follows', and prints exactly one exhibit number in thirty-one pages - a back-reference to four figures already drawn.

Excluded regions, one line each.
p5r1: The page's only region is not an exhibit: 427x179 pt of body PROSE pasted as a 94-dpi bitmap (the Cointegration bullet, display equation (1) x2t=beta0+x1t+eps_t and one paragraph of the ADF discussion), set at 100.7 per cent of the measure with no caption, no figure number and no text layer. No quote may be taken from it.
p8r3: Region 3 is an embedded 369x44 px raster at 96 dpi printing display equation (2) in fraction form with its number in parentheses at the right. Not the map credit, which is vector text and unboxed.
p10r3: Region 3 is the Revised-EROI formula block: two display formulas and one line of prose pasted as a 533x96 px bitmap at 96 dpi. It also carries a stray 1x1 pt 'P' glyph at (333,681).
p14r1: A pasted page image holding one page of prose and six display equations (8) to (12) plus an unnumbered two-line block, all right-tagged. No figure and no table print on this page at all; text layer 83 characters. Both raster pages sit at a left margin of 99 pt against the native 86 pt and in a different typeface.
p15r1: Equation strip: an unnumbered repeat of equation (10) over two paragraphs and a bullet. 0 per cent overlap with region 2 (the strip ends at y 503 px, the grid starts at 605), so this is not a nested re-detection of Table 2.
p15r3: Three numbered equations with right-aligned tags, pasted as a raster band. Not an exhibit: no caption, no number of its own.
p27r1: The appendix MATLAB listing: a code block bracketed by two full-width rules (y 774-775 and 854-855) whose single code line prints entirely in red (RGB 224,0,0) - a stray red run inside an otherwise black listing.
rules: Twenty-five of the twenty-eight rows carry a caption and every one of them prints it BELOW the artwork, tables included - the first paper in this run with no above-caption row at all [caption.position].

Three table rows have no caption to place: the unnumbered 'Model Parameters' grid on page 13 and both results grids on page 21 print a title bar or nothing, so their caption source is `none` and their verbatim is the empty string [caption.numbering].
Caption numbering is a single flat register, `Figure N:` and `Table N:`, with no variant spelling anywhere, and Figure 14's caption is the only one no text layer can see [caption.verbatim].
Five of the twenty-three figure rows are GRIDS sold as figures - Figures 3, 5, 7, 8 and 13 - so the word 'Figure' in this paper does not imply a drawn chart [geometry.family].

Four measured boxes buy eight printed figures: page 16 region 1 carries Figures 15 and 16, page 16 region 2 Figures 17 and 18, page 18 region 1 Figures 20 and 21, page 18 region 2 Figures 22 and 23 [geometry.panel_count].

Those four rows are `composite-panel` at `panel_count` 2 with a 1x2 layout and one quoted caption band spanning both names, because each measured box covers exactly the two plots and excludes both captions [geometry.panel_layout].
Figure 14 is the only high-count composite: fifteen regression panels in a 3x5 grid with unequal scales and no key for observed against fitted [geometry.panel_count].

Eight rows keep their legend inside the frame, five outside to the right, and ten carry none - and in six of those ten the absence is the defect: the map with ten unlabelled marker classes, the two satellite panels, and the four grids that never needed one [geometry.legend].
No row carries a colourbar [geometry.colorbar].

One row is three-dimensional: Figure 4's four perspective pies with drop shadows. The enum has no perspective-pie member, so it takes `perspective-bars`, and the deviation is stated on the row [geometry.three_d].
No artwork prints a value on a mark - every readable number in the paper is either an axis tick or a grid cell [geometry.data_labels].
The two paired strips repeat their own axes and legend inside each panel instead of declaring shared axes, and Figure 15/16's two panels even disagree on the y range [geometry.shared_axes].

Grid ruling splits two ways and the split follows the kind of grid: the denotation and parameter grids are full boxes with a centre vertical, while all three results grids print horizontals plus interior verticals with no outer side borders [table.rule_style].

No grid bands its rows and none merges a cell, although Table 2's two-level header is the paper's only false spanner - the state names abut the dividing rule and leave the 2050 header cells empty [table.merged_cells].
No grid puts a unit in its header: Table 2's unit survives only in the run-in sentence and Figure 7's only in its caption [table.units_in_header].
Not one grid aligns on the decimal point: every numeric column in the paper is centred, including Table 2's eight columns and Figure 13's percentage cells [table.decimal_aligned].
Only Table 2 carries two header rows, and its header is the one that leaves empty cells rather than spanning them [table.header_rows].
The five measured boxes run 296 to 496 pt against a 424 pt measure: Table 2 overruns the margin by about 72 pt, the other four sit between 66 and 88 per cent and are centred [table.width].
Every table and grid is portrait and none continues across a page break [table.orientation].

Seven of the thirty-five regions hold no exhibit and are excluded as `not-an-exhibit`: the bitmapped prose strip on page 5, the equation bitmaps on pages 8 and 10, the equation strips on page 15, the pasted equation page on 14 and the red-run MATLAB listing on page 27 [place.section_kind].

Exhibits cluster by section kind rather than by page: classification diagrams and profile grids sit under Data Processing and the profile section, every result chart sits under section 4.3 or 5.x, the single sensitivity plot under section 6 and the two target grids under Conclusions [place.section_path].

Citation is almost entirely deictic - 'the table below', 'the following graph', 'the figure above' - and the one numbered reference in the paper, 'Figure 9-12' on page 15, points BACK at four figures already printed [mention.lead_pattern].

Because that reference comes after the artwork it cites, every figure row in the paper carries an empty style list, a count of zero and a null first page; no figure is ever introduced by its number [mention.first_page].
Two printed table numbers exist and both are cited only by their introducing sentence; the three unnumbered grids are pointed at with 'these figures' and 'as follows' instead [mention.lead_sentence].

Lead sentences stay under twenty-five words and every one of them ends on a colon, because the paper introduces each exhibit with a run-in clause rather than a sentence that reads the artwork [mention.lead_sentence].
